svg.title: Multi-head attention uses parallel narrow heads
svg.desc: Multi-head attention splits representation width into narrower heads, computes attention in parallel, concatenates head outputs, and mixes them with an output projection.

g.text: Multi-head attention uses parallel narrow heads
Each head attends with separate projections; concatenation and Wₒ return width d.
SPLIT WIDTH → ATTEND IN PARALLEL → MIX
Each head has its own projections and attention pattern.
